summary: Animal Sounds Jigsaw Puzzles for Toddlers. All Animals of the Planet with Voices
description:
"Animal Sounds" is the jigsaw puzzle game for kids from 2 to 3 years old and for children from 4 - 5 years in English.

In this learning game, your smart kid will assemble the pictures of the various pets, domestic and wild animals of the planet from puzzle pieces. And after completion of each puzzle, the child will hear the real animal sounds and learn their names!
 
These jigsaw puzzles are perfect for kids from 2 to 3 years. And due to the different levels of difficulty, the game is suitable for babies from 1 year old and even for adults who love animals! 

Small toddlers need simple puzzles - they will be able to play the easy game of 9 jigsaw pieces. Playing for a child of 3, 4 or 5 years can be more difficult, he will be able to assemble a puzzle of 16 or 25 pieces. After each puzzle is assembled, the child learns how the planet animals sound like and how they are called in English.
 
The game is suitable both for boys, girls and even for children with autism and develops toddler's memory, attention, logical thinking, fine hand motor skills and just entertains kids without wifi or internet.
 
The kid begins to act up at the doctor's office or is bored at the airport or at the railway station? There is a solution! Just give him a kids tablet or phone, turn on “Animal Sounds - Kids Puzzles” and forget about whining and whims!
 
Our games for boys and girls are:
• jigsaw puzzles for kids from 2 - 3 years old - teach the planet animal's  names and hear the animal sounds
• speech therapy and development of fine motor skills for toddlers with autism
• turn the kids tablet into a cheerful zoo and listen to the sounds of animals
• offline kids games without wifi or internet
• home speech therapist, replenish the vocabulary of children in English, Spanish, French, German, Russian and the other languages
